career_ladder.note: Graduate-level executive and clerical cadres across the Union Territory of Ladakh encompass Junior Assistants, Accounts Assistants, Patwaris, Wasil Baqi Nawis (WBN), Statistical Assistants, and Naib Tehsildars recruited through the Ladakh Subordinate Services Recruitment Board (LAHDC Leh SSRB / Kargil DSSRB) for district cadres and through the Staff Selection Commission (SSC Selection Posts Ladakh) for UT and divisional cadres. Direct graduate recruitment enters at Pay Level 4 (Junior Assistant, Patwari, WBN: ₹25,500 - ₹81,100), Level 5 (Panchayat Account Assistant / Accounts Assistant: ₹29,200 - ₹92,300), Level 6B (Statistical Assistant: ₹35,600 - ₹1,12,800), or Level 6E (Naib Tehsildar / Legal Assistant: ₹35,900 - ₹1,13,500). In the ministerial stream, personnel advance to Senior Assistant (Level 5), Head Assistant (Level 6), Section Officer / Office Superintendent (Level 7), and Administrative Officer (Level 8/10). In the revenue executive stream, Patwaris advance to Girdawar / Revenue Inspector (Level 5), Naib Tehsildar (Level 6E), Tehsildar (Level 7 / Level 8: ₹44,900 - ₹1,51,100), and Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Assistant Commissioner / Ladakh Administrative Service (LAS) cadre (Level 10/11).

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment for Graduate Level posts in the Union Territory of Ladakh is conducted through an OMR-based Written Examination by the Ladakh Subordinate Services Recruitment Board (LAHDC Leh SSRB / Kargil DSSRB) for district cadre posts, and through Computer Based Examination (CBE) by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC Selection Posts Ladakh) for UT and divisional cadre vacancies. The objective test contains 100 multiple-choice questions spanning 4 sections: General Intelligence (Verbal & Non-Verbal reasoning), General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude (Graduate-level arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, and statistical charts), and English Language (Comprehension and grammar). LAHD-SSRB tests carry 100 marks (1 mark per question, 90 minutes, -0.25 negative marking). SSC tests carry 200 marks (2 marks per question, 60 minutes, -0.50 negative marking). Where prescribed by recruitment rules, a qualifying Skill Test (e.g. computer typing test at minimum 35 wpm for Junior Assistants; shorthand and typing for Steno-Typists; physical endurance walk of 25 km in 4 hours for Wildlife Foresters) is conducted, followed by Document Verification.

competition_benchmarks.note: Graduate Level posts in UT Ladakh (Junior Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Patwari, Naib Tehsildar) represent the most prestigious and fiercely contested administrative cadre vacancies in the Union Territory. Because recruitment requires a Ladakh Resident / Domicile Certificate, competition is focused among local graduates across Leh and Kargil. In the 2025 cycle (Advt No. 01/2025), LAHD-SSRB advertised 112 Graduate Level posts, with 235 candidates shortlisted for counselling from an estimated applicant pool of ~6,260 candidates.
